description: Translate the Legend Master reward and Bronze Master tournament sequence in MESPAK02 entry 15.

english:
Equipment acquired!
Royal M Star
blocks.review_note: Completes the DigiColosseum Legend Master reward and introduces the Bronze Master tournament. DWM ranks and existing equipment names follow the project glossary.

english:
Equipment acquired!
Niflheim
blocks.review_note: Completes the DigiColosseum Legend Master reward and introduces the Bronze Master tournament. DWM ranks and existing equipment names follow the project glossary.

english: You've climbed all the way to Platinum Master. Surely you won't quit here! The final rank is Legend Master. This is the real test! Remember, Taiki Kudo: when the next battle ends, you won't just be Taiki Kudo... you'll be Taiki, the Legend Master!
blocks.review_note: Completes the DigiColosseum Legend Master reward and introduces the Bronze Master tournament. DWM ranks and existing equipment names follow the project glossary.

english: Hurry and become Legend Master, Taiki Kudo! Everyone who knows you is hoping for it! And this time, your reward is super special! It's perfect for you... In fact, it's practically already yours!
blocks.review_note: Completes the DigiColosseum Legend Master reward and introduces the Bronze Master tournament. DWM ranks and existing equipment names follow the project glossary.

english: You did it! You're finally Legend Master! Congratulations! Incredible work! No Master can surpass you now! As promised, accept this super-special reward worthy of you!
blocks.review_note: Completes the DigiColosseum Legend Master reward and introduces the Bronze Master tournament. DWM ranks and existing equipment names follow the project glossary.

english:
Equipment acquired!
Gorgon
blocks.review_note: Completes the DigiColosseum Legend Master reward and introduces the Bronze Master tournament. DWM ranks and existing equipment names follow the project glossary.

english:
Key item acquired!
Legend Medal

english: Use it well, Taiki, the Legend Master!
blocks.review_note: Completes the DigiColosseum Legend Master reward and introduces the Bronze Master tournament. DWM ranks and existing equipment names follow the project glossary.

english: Hello, Taiki Kudo... No, Taiki, the Legend Master. There's no rank left for you to aim for. You're now the one everyone else looks up to. I have no reward left to give you... The shining future of the Digital World is your final reward. Everyone believes you'll win it for us.
blocks.review_note: Completes the DigiColosseum Legend Master reward and introduces the Bronze Master tournament. DWM ranks and existing equipment names follow the project glossary.

english: We'll always expect great things from you. Do your best, Taiki, the Legend Master!
blocks.review_note: Completes the DigiColosseum Legend Master reward and introduces the Bronze Master tournament. DWM ranks and existing equipment names follow the project glossary.

english: If you want to enter the battle arena, register first. Minomon at that counter handles DWM Tournament entries.
blocks.review_note: Completes the DigiColosseum Legend Master reward and introduces the Bronze Master tournament. DWM ranks and existing equipment names follow the project glossary.

english: Looks like you've already entered the DWM Tournament.
blocks.review_note: Completes the DigiColosseum Legend Master reward and introduces the Bronze Master tournament. DWM ranks and existing equipment names follow the project glossary.

english: Are you ready?
blocks.review_note: Completes the DigiColosseum Legend Master reward and introduces the Bronze Master tournament. DWM ranks and existing equipment names follow the project glossary.

english: Go to the battle arena?
blocks.review_note: Completes the DigiColosseum Legend Master reward and introduces the Bronze Master tournament. DWM ranks and existing equipment names follow the project glossary.

english: Yes, let's go.

english: No, not yet.

english: Come talk to me again when you're ready.
blocks.review_note: Completes the DigiColosseum Legend Master reward and introduces the Bronze Master tournament. DWM ranks and existing equipment names follow the project glossary.

english: If you've made up your mind, go ahead.
blocks.review_note: Completes the DigiColosseum Legend Master reward and introduces the Bronze Master tournament. DWM ranks and existing equipment names follow the project glossary.

english: The portal over there leads to the battle arena! Fight with honor!
blocks.review_note: Completes the DigiColosseum Legend Master reward and introduces the Bronze Master tournament. DWM ranks and existing equipment names follow the project glossary.

english: This portal is for Battle Masters only! Challengers must use the portal across from it!
blocks.review_note: Completes the DigiColosseum Legend Master reward and introduces the Bronze Master tournament. DWM ranks and existing equipment names follow the project glossary.

english: Welcome!
blocks.review_note: Completes the DigiColosseum Legend Master reward and introduces the Bronze Master tournament. DWM ranks and existing equipment names follow the project glossary.

english: Please come again!

english: Now, the DWM Tournament Bronze Master match! The challengers are Team Xros Heart, led by General Taiki Kudo!
blocks.review_note: Completes the DigiColosseum Legend Master reward and introduces the Bronze Master tournament. DWM ranks and existing equipment names follow the project glossary.

english: And the Bronze Master Battle Master is... A familiar face from Digimon Story! A quiet, unassuming man with influence behind the scenes! A smiling mad scientist in a white coat, known for bringing children to the Digital World! The legendary Battle Master leading Team Chrono...
blocks.review_note: Completes the DigiColosseum Legend Master reward and introduces the Bronze Master tournament. DWM ranks and existing equipment names follow the project glossary.

english: Mr. Kogure!
blocks.review_note: Completes the DigiColosseum Legend Master reward and introduces the Bronze Master tournament. DWM ranks and existing equipment names follow the project glossary.

english: That introduction makes me sound like a terrible villain... Or is it just me?
blocks.review_note: Completes the DigiColosseum Legend Master reward and introduces the Bronze Master tournament. DWM ranks and existing equipment names follow the project glossary.

english: Before the match, Battle Master Kogure, would you like to say a few words to the challenger?
blocks.review_note: Completes the DigiColosseum Legend Master reward and introduces the Bronze Master tournament. DWM ranks and existing equipment names follow the project glossary.

english: I've fought here ever since the DigiColosseum opened. Every match has been unforgettable. Taiki, you look like you'll put up a good fight. Surely you won't lose to an old man like me! Let's make a battle that will go down in history!
blocks.review_note: Completes the DigiColosseum Legend Master reward and introduces the Bronze Master tournament. DWM ranks and existing equipment names follow the project glossary.

english: Yes! I'll do my best!
blocks.review_note: Completes the DigiColosseum Legend Master reward and introduces the Bronze Master tournament. DWM ranks and existing equipment names follow the project glossary.

english: Battle Master Kogure's Team Chrono versus General Taiki's Team Xros Heart! The match of the century starts now!
blocks.review_note: Completes the DigiColosseum Legend Master reward and introduces the Bronze Master tournament. DWM ranks and existing equipment names follow the project glossary.

english: And the winner is Team Xros Heart! General Taiki Kudo has defeated Team Chrono... and Battle Master Kogure! So great, Taiki! Congratulations!
blocks.review_note: Completes the DigiColosseum Legend Master reward and introduces the Bronze Master tournament. DWM ranks and existing equipment names follow the project glossary.

english: Congratulations, General Taiki, and Team Xros Heart! You're now DWM-certified Bronze Masters. But remember: what matters most isn't your rank... It's how you live on the way to earning it, and after you've earned it.
blocks.review_note: Completes the DigiColosseum Legend Master reward and introduces the Bronze Master tournament. DWM ranks and existing equipment names follow the project glossary.

english: I'll work hard to honor the rank we've earned.
blocks.review_note: Completes the DigiColosseum Legend Master reward and introduces the Bronze Master tournament. DWM ranks and existing equipment names follow the project glossary.

english: Hmm... It seems I worried for nothing. I'm looking forward to seeing what you do, General Taiki!
blocks.review_note: Completes the DigiColosseum Legend Master reward and introduces the Bronze Master tournament. DWM ranks and existing equipment names follow the project glossary.

english: The team that burst onto the Digital World stage... Team Xros Heart and General Taiki! What kind of battle will they show us next? We look forward to seeing what they do from here on! See you next time!
blocks.review_note: Completes the DigiColosseum Legend Master reward and introduces the Bronze Master tournament. DWM ranks and existing equipment names follow the project glossary.

english: Now, the DWM Tournament Silver Master match! First, the challengers: Team Xros Heart, led by General Taiki Kudo!
blocks.review_note: Completes the DigiColosseum Legend Master reward and introduces the Bronze Master tournament. DWM ranks and existing equipment names follow the project glossary.

english: Facing them is their young, strong Battle Master! The shining hero of the brilliant Sunshine City!
blocks.review_note: Completes the DigiColosseum Legend Master reward and introduces the Bronze Master tournament. DWM ranks and existing equipment names follow the project glossary.

english: Battle Master Kou and Team Sunburst!
blocks.review_note: Completes the DigiColosseum Legend Master reward and introduces the Bronze Master tournament. DWM ranks and existing equipment names follow the project glossary.
